script_text: PISCES ALERT: Brace yourself, Pisces, because the cosmic currents are shifting dramatically this week, bringing powerful changes to your water element. Early on, Mercury in Virgo squares Neptune, your ruling planet, in your 1st House, creating communication fog, but Venus in Cancer trine your Sun brings sweet romantic vibes. Wednesday marks a major turning point as the Sun enters your 7th House of partnerships, highlighting your relationships. By late week, Mars enters your 5th House of creativity, sparking passion and bold moves in both love and career. The weekend looks bright with a lucky Jupiter transit in your 10th House of career, promising professional recognition. Wednesday is your power day because Venus in your 5th House trine your Pisces Sun, while Monday is your worst day as Mercury squares Neptune. Trust your deep intuition this week and avoid signing contracts on Monday. Follow for daily updates.
